statements.text: The phenomenal self-model (PSM) is a conscious, global and multimodal representation of the system as a whole, which may include psychological and social properties as well as the body. Its dynamic content is the content of the conscious self: present bodily sensations, emotional situation and the contents of experienced cognition. It is not a thing but an integrated process.

sources.quote: A conscious, global and multimodal representation of the cognitive system as a whole, which may also include psychological and social properties
This PSM is not a thing, but an integrated process.
